opportunities.title: The X100 Anatomy: How a Governance Takeover Became a $5M+ Four-Wallet Getaway
opportunities.why_now: Three separate Defiant reports (governance takeover, Uniswap drain, 4x400-ETH wallet split) are really one unfolding exploit that hasn't been synthesized yet.
opportunities.angle: Live post-mortem thread/blog stitching the governance-vote mechanics to the fund flow, ending with 'this is why governance tokens are an attack surface, not a feature'

opportunities.title: Initia Halted Its Own Chain to Stop a Hacker — Here's Why That's Both Smart and Terrifying
opportunities.why_now: A $2.6M exploit forced a live chain halt and reported token minting, a rare real-time admin-key intervention worth dissecting.
opportunities.angle: Explainer: what 'halting a blockchain' actually means for decentralization promises, with a checklist of what to watch before the postmortem drops

opportunities.title: Bitcoin Core Just Admitted AI Can Find Bugs Faster Than Devs Can Patch Them
opportunities.why_now: Bitcoin Core rewrote its security disclosure policy specifically because AI tooling makes one-prompt bug discovery trivial — a structural shift, not a one-off hack.
opportunities.angle: Analysis piece: what this policy change signals for every other chain/wallet that hasn't updated its threat model yet

opportunities.title: A Hardware Wallet Company Just Leaked Your Shipping Address — Here's the Keystone Breach
opportunities.why_now: Keystone's website breach exposed customer addresses and order details, turning a self-custody purchase into a physical security risk.
opportunities.angle: Security-led explainer on 'wallet metadata' as an attack vector — $5 wrench attacks don't need your seed phrase, just your mailing address

opportunities.title: Cysic Offered Its Hacker a 10% Bounty. The Hacker Took 100% and Went to Tornado Cash Anyway
opportunities.why_now: A live, almost comedic rejection of the standard white-hat negotiation playbook gives a perfect 'already priced' narrative on why bounty offers rarely work once funds move.
opportunities.angle: Short, punchy take on the incentive math of post-exploit negotiations — why mixers always win the race against goodwill
